name: Bobin T
title: Consultant, Design & Engineering
bio: Bobin brings over 14 years of experience in product design and user experience across enterprise SaaS, ERP, fintech, banking, eCommerce and travel. His strength lies in taking complex business workflows and turning them into products that people can understand and use without training. In recent years, his work has focused on AI product design and design engineering, where he defines how AI features should behave in front of users, builds working prototypes in code, and creates design systems that engineering teams can implement directly. He has led design teams and run his own design studio, and he works closely with product managers, engineers and business stakeholders from early discovery and user research through prototyping, usability testing and delivery, with a strong focus on designs that still hold up once they are built and in daily use.
